summary: Beta Bionics, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting its entry into an underwriting agreement on September 15, 2026, for an ordinary public follow-on equity offering. The company is selling 7,652,175 common shares at $17.25 per share plus 1,043,484 pre-funded warrants at $17.2499, for roughly $150 million gross proceeds, with a 30-day greenshoe on 1,304,348 shares. J.P. Morgan, Piper Sandler, Wells Fargo Securities and Leerink Partners served as representatives. Closing was expected September 17, 2026. Proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes, including Mint commercialization.
